from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,time,json,runpy,psutil,resource
R=Path('/workspaces/repository');O=R/'artifacts/candidate-scheduling-2026-10-25';M=O/'crossfit-memory';M.mkdir()
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{8,9,10,11});resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(24*1024**3,24*1024**3))
W=runpy.run_path(str(R/'bench/lean-native/linarith-oracle/memory_budget.py'))['MemoryWatchdog']
w=W(os.getpid(),48*1024**3,48*1024**3,2,'/tmp/gpu-smt-failure-profiler-20261025/repl',M)
if psutil.pid_exists(275822):
 p=psutil.Process(275822);assert abs(p.create_time()-1792894799.05)<.01
 w.include_owned_tree(275822,int(Path('/proc/275822/stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]),R/'artifacts/lean-failure-profile-2026-10-25/full480/profile')
w.start();cmd=[os.sys.executable,str(R/'bench/lean-candidate-scheduling/train-order.py'),'--out',str(O/'crossfit')];start=time.time()
try:
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=R,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
 (O/'crossfit.log').write_text(p.stdout)
 (O/'crossfit-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=cmd,exit=p.returncode,seconds=time.time()-start,utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime())),indent=2)+'\n')
 print(p.stdout[-4500:]);print('EXIT',p.returncode)
finally:
 w.stop();(O/'crossfit-memory-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(w.summary(),indent=2)+'\n')
